The reverse indexed scan is required by that order contract. Comments explain why the insertion point and disabled-prefix state exist; no global loop-style rule follows.",
        "The API unregisters protection at manifest setup and registers on non-app shutdown. Startup initialization asynchronously registers every inactive add-on unless the xpcshell environment flag bypasses AddonManager. This guard is a harness constraint, not production initialization success. The global observer and extension close/unpaint are separate lifetimes. Accepted code retains this source contract; no tests or assertions are added.",
        "The same exact complete Bug 2020584 primary is reused without repeating its body. Its extension-independent customization dialog and separate persistence observer rationale remain attributed author discussion.",
        "B reads C3's complete D286165 timeline and the single actual author inline. Startup-disabled protection is present in the constructor. The reported unrelated xpcshell failures correspond to the explicit environment guard; linked Firefox source and Try jobs were not opened. The proposed extension-aware currentSet getter/setter and identifier migration are alternatives, not adopted behavior or naming rules. No install/disable/customize/re-enable cycle was executed."
